description: Test suite for shared channel and remote cluster management in Mattermost, including permission checks, pagination, and remote cluster info retrieval.

methods.name: setupForSharedChannels
methods.description: Initializes configuration for shared channels and remote cluster service.

methods.name: TestGetAllSharedChannelsWithSharedChannelManagerRole
methods.description: Tests visibility of shared channels for users with shared_channel_manager role.

methods.name: TestGetAllSharedChannels
methods.description: Tests pagination and error handling when retrieving shared channels.

methods.name: TestGetRemoteClusterById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of remote cluster info and handling of invalid IDs.

methods.name: TestCreateDirectChannelWithRemoteUser
methods.description: Tests creation of direct message channels with remote users and sharing constraints.

methods.name: TestGetSharedChannelRemotesByRemoteCluster
methods.description: Validates retrieval of shared channel remotes filtered by remote cluster with permission checks and pagination.

methods.name: TestInviteRemoteClusterToChannel
methods.description: Checks permissions and behavior when inviting remote clusters to channels.

methods.name: TestUninviteRemoteClusterToChannel
methods.description: Checks permissions and behavior when uninviting remote clusters from channels.

methods.name: TestSharedChannelEndpointsWithSharedChannelManagerRole
methods.description: Verifies API access for shared_channel_manager role.
